title: contract solicitations - u.s. embassy in north macedonia
paragraphs: u.s. embassy skopje is pleased to announce online applications for vendor’s registration with the u.s. government. federal acquisition regulation (far) , subpart 4.11—system for award management (sam) requires that all prospective contractors must be registered in the sam database prior to award of a contract or agreements. in order to do business with u.s. embassy skopje, your company must be registered in ncage and sam.gov. the instructions follow: ncage registration sam registration sam entity registration checklist (english, macedonian, albanian) sam.gov entity validation u.s. federal contractor registration (usfcrus) — usfcr is not a government agency. usfcr is a third-party consulting firm, which provides assistance with sam.gov processing and filing, small-business certifications and registrations, and other government contractor services and technologies.
